card.name: Words counting occurrences or intervals
card.fires_on: Nouns that count or space repeated events, such as weeks after 'every 4', time after 'first', dose, round, periods, or each. It fires where the phrase describes frequency or repetition.

modes.label: Dosing intervals
modes.description: The unit word after a number in 'every N weeks' dosing schedules.

modes.label: Occurrence words in general text
modes.description: Words like time, round, each or anew that mark a single instance or repeat of an event.
modes.example: A Critically Endangered species of Madagascan frog has bred successfully for the first<< time>> at North Queensferry’s Deep Sea

card.writes: It suppresses words for repeating or restarting (twice, several times, restarted) and promotes words for gradual progression.
card.plain: It marks words that count how often or how many times something happens, like 'every 4 weeks' or 'the first time'.
